needs_review.issue: International campuses under-covered relative to budget
needs_review.finding: FOCUS states 31 missionaries across 8-9 universities in Austria, Germany, Ireland and Northern Ireland, but only ~9 individual pages surfaced across three international queries. The Austrian campuses (Graz, Vienna, St. Poelten) returned campus/press pages and zero personal pages.
needs_review.recommendation: The Austrian cohort is very likely indexed under German-language campus names. A follow-up wave should try 'Karl-Franzens', 'Universitaet Wien', 'Fachhochschule St. Poelten' and German-language phrasing rather than the English city names.

needs_review.issue: Digital Outreach axis largely resistant to search
needs_review.finding: Two queries on the Digital Outreach campus returned the campus page and press releases; only one of the two produced personal pages at all (Hellwig, Sloan, Rock, LeMay), and the campus page itself never named its team in a snippet.
needs_review.recommendation: Digital Outreach missionaries do not appear to carry a searchable campus string in their page text. Try role phrasing ('Digital Outreach missionary', 'Digital Campus Team Director') or approach via focus.org/give/all-missionaries in a wave where page fetching is available.

needs_review.issue: No sensitive-region or anonymized workers encountered
needs_review.finding: No FOCUS page in this slice used initials-only slugs, withheld a surname, or sat under a sensitive/creative-access category. The one initial-bearing name found (Ireland M. Johnson) carries a full given name and surname.
needs_review.recommendation: None needed - recorded so a later wave does not re-check.

needs_review.finding: No snippet in this slice introduced a name via 'their children', 'son', 'daughter' or a child count. The Hickson page is titled '...Family' but the title names only the two spouses.
needs_review.recommendation: None needed. Flagged so the reviewer knows the child rule was applied and not merely unexercised.
